title: DJPK general transfer allocation 2024: Dana Bagi Hasil (DBH) by type, province governments, Indonesia

columns.province_code: BPS province code (kode_bps) of the province government (pemerintah provinsi). Names and Kemendagri codes in 'provinces'.
columns.status: Empty; the table carries no markers.

dbh_pph.name: DBH Pajak: Pajak Penghasilan (PPh, income tax)
dbh_pph.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_pbb.name: DBH Pajak: Pajak Bumi dan Bangunan (PBB, land and building tax)
dbh_pbb.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_cht.name: DBH Pajak: Cukai Hasil Tembakau (CHT, tobacco excise)
dbh_cht.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_tax_total.name: Total DBH Pajak (tax revenue sharing) = PPh + PBB + CHT
dbh_tax_total.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_forestry_iiuph_psdh.name: DBH SDA Kehutanan: IIUPH/PSDH (forestry licence fees and resource provision)
dbh_forestry_iiuph_psdh.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_forestry_dr.name: DBH SDA Kehutanan: Dana Reboisasi (DR, reforestation fund)
dbh_forestry_dr.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_oil_gas.name: DBH SDA Minyak dan Gas Bumi (MIGAS, oil and gas)
dbh_oil_gas.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_minerba.name: DBH SDA Mineral dan Batubara (MINERBA, minerals and coal; DJPK does not split coal from other minerals)
dbh_minerba.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_fisheries.name: DBH SDA Perikanan (fisheries)
dbh_fisheries.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_geothermal.name: DBH SDA Panas Bumi (geothermal)
dbh_geothermal.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_sda_total.name: Total DBH SDA (natural resource revenue sharing) = IIUPH/PSDH + DR + MIGAS + MINERBA + PERIKANAN + PANAS BUMI
dbh_sda_total.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

dbh_palm_oil.name: DBH Lainnya: Sawit (palm oil)
dbh_palm_oil.source: DJPK Kemenkeu, Rincian Dana Transfer Umum TA 2024

pdf.title: Rincian Dana Transfer Umum Tahun Anggaran 2024 Menurut Provinsi/Kabupaten/Kota (DAU dan DBH)
pdf.publisher: Direktorat Jenderal Perimbangan Keuangan (DJPK), Kementerian Keuangan
pdf.received: uploaded by the user to .inbox on 2026-11-16; the user describes it as the 2024 allocation (pagu alokasi)

notes: Values are budget allocations (pagu) for 2024, not realised transfers (realisasi).
Province-government rows only. The table's regency and city rows are read so that every column can be checked against JUMLAH, but are not written.
A dash in the table is a nil allocation and is written as 0: the table's own totals (columns 6, 13 and 15) and the JUMLAH row hold exactly only with dashes counted as zero.
DBH Minerba covers coal and other minerals together; DJPK publishes no coal-only split.
The table names Kepulauan Bangka Belitung 'Bangka Belitung'; that label is matched by a declared fix.

identities.check: dbh_sda_total = dbh_forestry_iiuph_psdh + dbh_forestry_dr + dbh_oil_gas + dbh_minerba + dbh_fisheries + dbh_geothermal

format.missing: a missing row means the source has no value; no placeholder values are written
format.layout: one value per row: key columns, then status, then value

status: final, or no marker in the source
